_about: Chat filter categories. Each is a feature switch; patterns match the line with colour codes removed. Copy to config/sbcompanion/patterns/ to change, /sbc reload applies.

categories.title: Join and welcome spam
categories.description: Hides the welcome lines, profile ids and update notes when you join SkyBlock.

categories.title: Warp and transfer lines
categories.description: Hides Warping..., Sending to server and similar transfer messages.

categories.title: Guild and event EXP lines
categories.description: Hides lines like You earned 2 GEXP from playing SkyBlock!
patterns: ^You earned \d+ GEXP( \+ \d+ Event EXP)? from playing SkyBlock!$
^You earned \d+ Event EXP from playing SkyBlock!$

categories.title: Kill combo lines
categories.description: Hides +5 Kill Combo and its buffs.
patterns: ^Your Kill Combo has expired! You reached a \d+ Kill Combo!$

categories.title: Cooldown warnings
categories.description: Hides 'Ability on cooldown' and 'no more charges'. The HUD already shows them.

categories.title: Friend and guild join/leave
categories.description: Hides Friend > X joined. and Guild > X left.

categories.title: Pet summon lines
categories.description: Hides You summoned your X and You despawned your X.

categories.title: Bazaar, auction and bank progress lines
categories.description: Hides the submitting, executing and claiming steps of orders and auctions, and depositing or withdrawing coins.

categories.title: Dungeon combat spam
categories.description: Hides damage, healing, orb and buff lines inside a dungeon run.
patterns: ^A mystical force in this room prevents you from using that ability!$
^.* is ready to use! Press DROP to activate it!$

categories.title: Repeating server reminders
categories.description: Hides reminders that repeat constantly: blocks in the way, and trees you cannot damage yet.
patterns: ^You can't use this while in combat!$
^You cannot damage a tree while it is regenerating!$
^The toughness of this tree is way too high!$

categories.title: Stash reminders
categories.description: Hides every stash line. Off, the reminders are shortened to one clickable line instead.
patterns: ^One or more items didn't fit in your inventory and were added to your item stash! .*

categories.title: Other players' sacrifices
categories.description: Hides SACRIFICE! and BONUS LOOT! about other players at the Dragon's Lair.

categories.title: Other players' rare rewards
categories.description: Hides RARE REWARD! about other players' chests.
patterns: ^RARE REWARD! \S+ found a .* in their .* Chest!$

categories.title: Parkour lines
categories.description: Hides started, finished, checkpoint and cancelled parkour lines.
patterns: ^(Started|Finished|Reached checkpoint #\d+ for|Wrong checkpoint for|You haven't reached all checkpoints for) parkour .*

categories.title: Unclaimed reward reminders
categories.description: Hides You haven't claimed your X Rewards yet! Talk to ...

categories.title: Hoppity's Hunt has begun
categories.description: Hides the line when the hunt starts.
patterns: ^Hoppity's Hunt has begun! Help Hoppity find his Chocolate Rabbit Eggs across SkyBlock each day during the Spring!$

categories.title: Event level up
categories.description: Hides You are now Event Level, the Event Silver you earned and the LEVEL UP line.

categories.title: Griffin burrow lines
categories.description: Hides burrows dug, Griffin Feathers and coins dug out; the Diana cards count them.
patterns: ^You (?:dug out a Griffin Burrow|finished the Griffin burrow chain)!.*$
^RARE DROP! You dug out a Griffin Feather!$

categories.title: Hoppity egg appeared
categories.description: Hides HOPPITY'S HUNT A Chocolate X Egg has appeared!
patterns: ^HOPPITY'S HUNT A Chocolate .* Egg has appeared!$

categories.title: Hunting shard chatter
categories.description: Hides 'X ate too much and passed out!' and other redundant shard lines.
patterns: ^\S+ ate too much and passed out! You caught it!$
^You caught yourself an? \S+! The shard was sent to your Hunting Box!$

categories.title: Anita fortune reminder
categories.description: Hides [NPC] Jacob: Your Anita's Talisman is giving you ...
patterns: ^\[NPC\] Jacob: Your Anita's .* is giving you .* during the contest!$

categories.title: Arachne call lines
categories.description: Hides Arachne's Calling and Arachne Crystal placed from other players, also inside the Sanctuary. The Arachne fight filter is the finer one.
patterns: ^☄ .* placed an Arachne Crystal! Something is awakening!$

categories.title: Watchdog announcements
categories.description: Hides the [WATCHDOG ANNOUNCEMENT] blocks.
patterns: ^Watchdog has banned .* players in the last 7 days\.$
^Staff have banned an additional .* in the last 7 days\.$

categories.title: Fire sale announcements
categories.description: Hides FIRE SALE lines.
patterns: ^♨ Fire Sales for .* are starting soon!$
^♨ Visit the Community Shop in the next .* to grab yours! \[WARP\]$
^♨ A Fire Sale for .* is starting soon!$
^♨ Selling multiple items for a limited time!$

categories.title: Sky Mall buff lines
categories.description: Hides New day! Your Sky Mall buff changed! Away from the mining islands only; there it stays.
patterns: ^New day! Your Sky Mall buff changed!$
^New buff: (?:Gain )?(?:.+) (?:Mining Speed|Mining Fortune|more Powder while mining|Pickaxe Ability cooldowns|chance to find Golden and Diamond Goblins|Titanium drops)\.$
^You can disable this messaging by toggling Sky Mall in your /hotm!$

categories.title: Lottery buff lines
categories.description: Hides the daily line that your Lottery buff changed.
patterns: ^You can disable this messaging by toggling Lottery in your /hotf!$

categories.title: Trade and visit advertisements
categories.description: Hides lines in public chat selling, buying or asking for visits, and keeps everything else.

categories.title: Implosion and wave lines
categories.description: Hides Your Implosion hit X enemies ... and Your Molten Wave ...
patterns: ^Your (Implosion|Molten Wave|Spirit Sceptre) hit \d+ enem(y|ies) for .* damage\.$

categories.title: Teleport ability lines
categories.description: Hides There are blocks in the way! and similar from the Aspect of the End.

categories.title: Dungeon class stat lines
categories.description: Hides [Berserk] Melee Damage 48% -> 88% and the other class buff lines at the start of a run.

categories.title: Boss dialogue
categories.description: Hides [BOSS] Name: ... speech lines. The Dungeon copilot still reads them.

categories.title: Hypixel lobby announcements
categories.description: In the lobbies outside SkyBlock, hides player joins, mystery boxes, prototype and tournament lines.
patterns: You can now create your own Hypixel SMP server!
For the best experience, click the text below to enable Snow\s.*Particles in this lobby!\s*.*Click to enable Snow Particles
^➤ You have reached your Hype limit! Add Hype to Prototype Lobby minigames by right-clicking with the Hype Diamond!$
HYPIXEL is hosting a BED WARS DOUBLES tournament!
HYPIXEL BED WARS DOUBLES tournament is live!
HYPIXEL is hosting a TNT RUN tournament!
You are still radiating with Generosity!

categories.title: Teleport pad lines
categories.description: Hides that you warped from one pad to the other, and pads without a destination.
patterns: ^This Teleport Pad does not have a destination set!$

categories.title: Chocolate Factory upgrades
categories.description: Hides Hypixel's lines about employees promoted, barn capacity and chocolate per click.
patterns: ^Your Rabbit Barn capacity has been increased to .* Rabbits!$
^You will now produce .* Chocolate per click!$

categories.title: Legacy items warning
categories.description: Hides the reminder that you have legacy items to exchange in /legacytrades.
patterns: ^You currently have one or more Legacy Items in your inventory or sacks that are no longer used throughout the game! Exchange them in the Legacy Trades menu, accessed through /legacytrades!$

categories.title: Feast Chef Ted
categories.description: Hides Thanks for the donation! Kernels going into your purse while you farm.
patterns: ^\[NPC\] Feast Chef Ted: Thanks for the donation! I've added a Kernel to your purse\.$

categories.title: Heal lines
categories.description: Hides You healed yourself, and that someone healed you.

categories.title: Show-off lines
categories.description: Hides other players using /show: is holding, is wearing, has.

categories.title: All player deaths
categories.description: Hides every death line, near or far. To hide only those far away, use Hide far death messages.

categories.title: Chicken Head eggs
categories.description: Hides You laid an egg!
